name: join aggregates
sql: SELECT u.id, COUNT(t.id) AS ticket_count FROM users u JOIN support_tickets t ON t.email=u.email GROUP BY u.id

name: partial unresolved argument
sql: SELECT CONCAT(id, missing_date) AS label FROM users

name: branch values only
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN email IS NULL THEN id ELSE created_at END AS value FROM users

name: simple case operand excluded
sql: SELECT CASE email WHEN 'a' THEN id ELSE id+1 END FROM users

name: constant branch and filtered constant
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN email IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 1 FROM users WHERE profile IS NOT NULL

name: window arguments only
sql: SELECT SUM(id) OVER(PARTITION BY email ORDER BY created_at), ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY email) FROM users

name: aggregate function arguments
sql: SELECT MAX(subject), COUNT(email), COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets

name: filtered aggregate
sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FILTER(WHERE email IS NOT NULL) FROM users

name: nested ordinary functions
sql: SELECT COALESCE(LOWER(email), CONCAT(id, context_key)) FROM users

name: duplicate output aliases
sql: SELECT email AS x, id AS x FROM users

name: cte explicit names
sql: WITH c(x,y) AS (SELECT email,id FROM users) SELECT x,y+1 FROM c

name: cte sibling output isolation
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT u.email, COUNT(t.id) AS tickets FROM users u JOIN support_tickets t ON t.user_id=u.id GROUP BY u.email) SELECT tickets FROM c

name: cte shadows physical relation
sql: WITH users AS (SELECT subject AS email FROM support_tickets) SELECT email FROM users

name: nested cte shadows outer cte
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT id FROM users) SELECT x.id FROM (WITH c AS (SELECT user_id AS id FROM support_tickets) SELECT id FROM c) x

name: correlated scalar value
sql: SELECT (SELECT MAX(t.subject) FROM support_tickets t WHERE t.user_id=u.id) FROM users u

name: correlated returned expression
sql: SELECT (SELECT u.email FROM support_tickets t WHERE t.user_id=u.id LIMIT 1) FROM users u

name: union by position
sql: SELECT email AS contact,id FROM users UNION ALL SELECT subject,user_id FROM support_tickets

name: select star
sql: SELECT u.* FROM users u

name: join using output order
sql: SELECT * FROM users u JOIN support_tickets t USING (email,id)

name: right join using
sql: SELECT id,email FROM users u RIGHT JOIN support_tickets t USING(id,email)

name: full join using
sql: SELECT id FROM users u FULL JOIN support_tickets t USING(id)

name: natural join output order
sql: SELECT * FROM users NATURAL JOIN support_tickets

name: qualified stars retain originals
sql: SELECT u.id,t.id FROM users u JOIN support_tickets t USING(id)

name: ambiguous source
sql: SELECT CONCAT(u.id,email) FROM users u JOIN support_tickets t ON u.id=t.user_id

name: function hidden body ignored
sql: SELECT lookup_email_by_id(id) FROM users

name: postgres json cte
sql: WITH c AS(SELECT profile->'contact' AS contact FROM users) SELECT contact->>'email' FROM c

name: postgres json index
sql: SELECT profile->'contacts'->0->>'email' FROM users

name: postgres text path
sql: SELECT profile#>>'{contacts,0,email}' FROM users

name: postgres array text path
sql: SELECT profile#>ARRAY['contact','email'] FROM users

name: postgres dynamic key
sql: SELECT profile->>context_key FROM users

name: postgres conservative object
sql: WITH c AS(SELECT jsonb_build_object('contact',email,'uid',id) AS obj FROM users) SELECT obj->>'contact' FROM c

name: postgres array generator
sql: SELECT e.value->>'email' FROM users u CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(u.profile->'contacts') AS e(value)

name: postgres record constructor
sql: SELECT ROW(id,email) FROM users

name: snowflake json cte
sql: WITH c AS(SELECT profile:contact AS contact FROM users) SELECT contact:email::STRING FROM c

name: snowflake indexed path
sql: SELECT profile:contacts[0].email::STRING FROM users

name: snowflake dynamic get
sql: SELECT GET(profile,context_key) FROM users

name: snowflake literal get path
sql: SELECT GET_PATH(profile,'contacts[0].email') FROM users

name: snowflake dotted literal key
sql: SELECT profile:"contact.email" FROM users

name: snowflake conservative object
sql: WITH c AS(SELECT OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('contact',email,'uid',id) AS obj FROM users) SELECT obj:contact FROM c

name: snowflake function star
sql: SELECT ARRAY_AGG(OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(u.*)) FROM users u

name: snowflake count qualified star
sql: SELECT COUNT(u.*) FROM users u

name: snowflake function star exclude
sql: SELECT ARRAY_AGG(OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(* EXCLUDE (profile,context_key))) FROM users

name: snowflake function star ilike
sql: SELECT OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(* ILIKE '%id') FROM users

name: snowflake star modifiers
sql: SELECT * EXCLUDE profile REPLACE(CONCAT(email,context_key) AS email) RENAME email AS contact FROM users

name: snowflake flatten
sql: SELECT f.value:email::STRING FROM users u, LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT=>u.profile:contacts) f

name: snowflake flatten literal path
sql: SELECT f.value:email FROM users u, LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT=>u.profile,PATH=>'contacts') f

name: redshift super navigation
sql: SELECT u.profile.contact.email FROM users u

name: redshift super index
sql: SELECT u.profile.contacts[0].email FROM users u

name: redshift prior target alias
sql: SELECT id+1 AS next_id, next_id*2 AS doubled FROM users

name: redshift source alias collision
sql: SELECT id AS email, LOWER(email) FROM users

name: aws tickit outer join
sql: SELECT listing.listid,SUM(pricepaid) AS price,SUM(commission) AS comm FROM listing LEFT OUTER JOIN sales ON sales.listid=listing.listid WHERE listing.listid BETWEEN 1 AND 5 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

name: aws running total
sql: SELECT dateid,pricepaid,SUM(pricepaid) OVER(ORDER BY dateid ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS sumpaid FROM sales

name: dbt customer mart
sql: WITH customers AS(SELECT * FROM stg_customers), orders AS(SELECT * FROM stg_orders), payments AS(SELECT * FROM stg_payments), customer_orders AS(SELECT customer_id,MIN(order_date) AS first_order,MAX(order_date) AS most_recent_order,COUNT(order_id) AS number_of_orders FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id), customer_payments AS(SELECT orders.customer_id,SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM payments LEFT JOIN orders ON payments.order_id=orders.order_id GROUP BY orders.customer_id), final AS(SELECT customers.customer_id,customers.first_name,customers.last_name,customer_orders.first_order,customer_orders.most_recent_order,customer_orders.number_of_orders,customer_payments.total_amount AS customer_lifetime_value FROM customers LEFT JOIN customer_orders ON customers.customer_id=customer_orders.customer_id LEFT JOIN customer_payments ON customers.customer_id=customer_payments.customer_id) SELECT * FROM final

name: snowflake car sales tax
sql: SELECT src:vehicle[0].price::NUMBER*0.10 AS tax FROM car_sales ORDER BY tax

name: purchase analysis adapted to postgres
sql: WITH purchases AS(SELECT id AS user_id,profile FROM users WHERE id>0) SELECT i.value->>'item_name' AS item_name,SUM((i.value->>'quantity')::INT) FROM purchases p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.profile->'items') i(value) WHERE p.user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

name: dynamic path followed by key does not rewrite selector origin
sql: SELECT GET(profile,context_key):email FROM users

name: unknown table function retains visible inputs
sql: SELECT f.result FROM users u CROSS JOIN LATERAL custom_table_function(u.id) f

name: path with escaped text tokens
sql: SELECT profile #>> '{"a,b","x\\y"}' FROM users

name: alias hides original table name
sql: SELECT users.id,u.email FROM users u

name: scalar extract and substring
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at),SUBSTRING(email FROM 1 FOR id) FROM users

name: membership subquery keeps its own scope
sql: SELECT id IN(SELECT user_id FROM support_tickets WHERE email IS NOT NULL) FROM users

name: ordered-set percentile value
sql: SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY id) FROM users

name: native date part is not a missing column
sql: SELECT DATEADD(day,id,created_at),DATEDIFF(day,created_at,created_at) FROM users

name: dynamic generator path does not attach to selector
sql: SELECT f.value:email FROM users u,LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT=>u.profile,PATH=>u.context_key) f

name: flatten constructed object remains a union
sql: SELECT f.value:email FROM users u,LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT=>OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('x',u.email,'y',u.id),PATH=>'x') f
